purpose: Fourth narratives batch (3.36): the chosen polity plans with the identity evidence and the territory-coverage arithmetic.

method.eligibility: Wikidata P31 classes must include a polity class; islands, people, families, positions, events, cultures and history topics are excluded, with five hand exclusions documented below.
method.region: documented coordinate-box rule on record centres, reviewed by hand for European metropoles
method.quotas: Deliberate policy change for the fourth batch: Europe takes 32 of 70 plans (about 46 per cent) while the under-covered regions - Africa, west-central Asia, east Asia, South Asia, the Americas, Southeast Asia and Oceania - take the remaining 38 by score

handExclusions.reason: "English overseas possessions" is a description of a collection of territories, not a polity with its own records.
Greenland is an island territory; the atlas records bound to it describe the island and its Danish autonomy rather than a sovereign polity of its own.
"History of Sumer" is a history topic, not a polity.
handExclusions.title: history of Sumer

handExclusions.reason: "History of Tibet" is a history topic, not a polity.
handExclusions.title: history of Tibet

handExclusions.reason: "French Colonial Africa" is a region, not a polity.
handExclusions.title: French Colonial Africa

handExclusions.reason: Kutai: the classes include a monarchy, but the only English article under this name documents a historical region and the Kutai people rather than a state, so it was registered as a gap in the previous round as well.
